projects.name: claude-plugins-official
projects.oneliner: Anthropic's official directory of Claude Code plugins, maintained by the Claude team.
projects.why: The first-party plugin registry for Claude Code, trending this week with over 1K new stars per day.

projects.name: Orca
projects.oneliner: A desktop and mobile tool for managing a fleet of coding agents across Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
projects.why: Over 1K stars daily this week; the fleet-management approach to coding agents is drawing heavy interest.

projects.name: VoiceStudio
projects.oneliner: Open-source voice cloning, transcription, and text-to-speech, positioned as an ElevenLabs alternative.
projects.why: Over 2K new stars per day this week; the fastest-rising voice-AI repo on GitHub.

projects.name: Hyperframes
projects.oneliner: Renders video from HTML, built for agents that need to produce and edit video programmatically.
projects.why: Over 5.6K stars this week; from HeyGen, the AI video company.

projects.name: CLI-Anything
projects.oneliner: Makes any software usable by AI agents through a generated command-line interface.
projects.why: From HKU Data Science Lab; 580 new stars per day as teams connect legacy tools to agents.

projects.name: scientific-agent-skills
projects.oneliner: 177 agent skills and 100 scientific database connectors for research workflows.
projects.why: 879 new stars per day; practical research automation built on Claude and other agents.

projects.name: ai-job-search
projects.oneliner: An AI job application framework built on Claude Code that manages the full application lifecycle.
projects.why: Over 1.3K new stars daily; an agent-driven approach to job hunting.

projects.name: context-mode
projects.oneliner: Optimizes context windows for AI coding agents through MCP and hooks.
projects.why: Over 4.2K stars this week; addresses a common pain point in long agent sessions.

projects.name: xerj
projects.oneliner: A search engine that indexes code, docs, logs, and PDFs so AI agents can find what they need.
projects.why: Over 1.1K new stars per day; fills the gap between agents and unstructured project data.

projects.name: StarSkirmish
projects.oneliner: Benchmarks Gemini 4 Argon playing StarCraft against other frontier models.
projects.why: 226 points on Show HN; an early, creative test of Argon's planning and real-time decision-making.

projects.name: REA
projects.oneliner: One MCP server for reverse engineering apps, binaries, and runtime behavior from any coding agent.
projects.why: Still one of the fastest-growing repos; an agent skill for security researchers and engineers.

projects.name: Pancake
projects.oneliner: A go-to-market toolkit that AI agents can use to run sales, marketing, and outreach campaigns.
projects.why: 585 on Product Hunt this week; agents doing GTM is a new category.

projects.name: llmspeed
projects.oneliner: Feel how fast a local LLM runs before buying hardware, with side-by-side model comparisons.
projects.why: 111 points on Show HN; practical tool for anyone considering local inference.

projects.name: jev-browser-wingman
projects.oneliner: Hands an agent's browser clicks to TypeSafe's Jev, which picks the element for each step.
projects.why: One of the first third-party tools built on Jev; still gaining traction as Jev's ecosystem grows.

projects.name: Diagram Design
projects.oneliner: 42 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot, as self-contained HTML and SVG.
projects.why: Continuing to trend two weeks after launch; diagram skills remain in high demand for agents.
